example_definitions.runnable-after-prerequisites: Uses implemented scenario schema and source-observed commands after documented setup. Historical smoke results, where present, are separate from current-source qualification.
example_definitions.pending-capability-gated: A schema-valid descriptor intentionally fails a missing capability before interaction; not a runnable drag test.

scenario_examples.setup: SETUP: loaded generated video fixture; player focused, VoiceOver off, default shortcuts; controls-always-visible false and benchmark chrome pin disabled. No menu, popover or focus pins; pointer stationary. A real Space play transition hides controls, and a real Space pause transition reveals them. Hooks only establish setup/read state; no pointer, timeout, or presented-frame qualification.

SETUP: launch one isolated benchmark player; no media fixture needed. Requires Accessibility and Screen Recording for capture. Bounded inspection/window existence and capture smoke only; does not qualify every control or display output.

historical_smoke.scope: named input/state/capture steps only; current-source revalidation pending

scenario_examples.setup: SETUP: open generated fixtures/video.mp4 (12 seconds) in the isolated benchmark build before running; default shortcut overrides, VoiceOver off, player focused, no text field/modal/popover. Hooks establish pause/seek setup and read state; Space/Right/Left are real input. Main-actor state assertions are not visible frame or audio-output proof.

historical_smoke.scope: named input/state/capture steps only; current-source revalidation pending

scenario_examples.setup: SETUP: one visible focused player and no other app windows or modals; shared benchmark preference domain; verify effective preferences before use. No media fixture. Command-comma and Command-W are real native menu shortcuts. This requests Settings, observes a second owned window, inspects, sends close, and checks player focus return. It does not identify Settings content; per-control settings changes and menu traversal remain pending.

PENDING, deliberately capability-gated; not a drag test. Source now publishes illiquid.timeline.grip in swiftui-player-root-top-left-points; the grip remains accessibility-hidden. Native input needs Quartz global logical points. Fresh geometry transformation, source revision checks, press/move/release and outcome assertions are not implemented here. Missing synthetic requirement timeline-grip-global-input must fail; never remove the gate and count inspection as drag coverage.

SETUP: single visible focused player window, normal windowed mode, no modal/popup/Settings or PiP, usable macOS GUI. No media fixture needed. Command-F is the actual Toggle Fullscreen menu shortcut. State tracks fullscreen request/completion but does not establish compositor presentation, resize hit targets, minimize/restore or multi-display behavior.
